question: Which of the following family of flowering plants is zygomorphic (meaning a flower can be cut into two equal halves only through a radius), bisexual and complete and whose calyx consists of five sepals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fabaceae family.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
 

 **Family**
 Flower type
 Calyx
 Corolla
 Androecium
 Gynoecium
 Floral Formula
 
 

 
 
**Fabaceae**

 
 bisexual, zygomorphic
 5 sepals
 5 petals; 1 posterior, 2 lateral wings, 2 anterior ones forming keel
 10 stamens; joined partially into two structures
 Superior ovary with one carpel
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17e9f635f05a8f8e53199bf656fc65c6feb7cc4ef0de9720e2395dd8eb50e963.png] 
 
 

 Solanaceae
 bisexual, actinomorphic
 5 sepals united
 5 petals united
 5 stamens attached to petals
 Superior ovary with 2 carpels
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10918c9b74a171829b8870c26b0f870217bd5a6d33d8563fffd383907c5ba3fb.png] 
 
 

 Liliaceae
 bisexual, actinomorphic
 (3+3) sepals and petals combined(tepals)
 two whorls of tepals (3+3)
 (3+3) stamens combined with tapels
 Superior ovary with 3 carpels
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dc9d3892fa4c22cb147a43b3535adcf798d97262609f38020804a1baca93f1f.png] 
 
 

 Brassicaceae
 bisexual, actinomorphic
 4 sepals arranged in two whorls
 4 petals
 6 stamens; 2 lateral stamens are smaller and 4 median stamens are larger
 superior ovary; two carpels
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e087f6e052e0f7acbca874fa72d80f1e5a51ccc078a42a1cbd1265e784a02215.png]
